mapDesc.iron_gate: A tight old town: the townhall square on its rise in the middle, the factories and the iron gate checkpoint either side, the hospital north and the gas station south. A canal cuts through the town.
mapDesc.ardennes: A valley town between a snowy mountainside and a wide river: the sawmill on the slope, the fishing hamlet on the point, the hotel square and the church on the upper terrace, the station and the rail yard by the quay.
mapDesc.lyon: A hilltop village of stone houses in terraces, ringed by lavender fields: the church on top, the upper square, the market, the watermill by the stream and the farm.
mapDesc.bilbao: A riverside city under siege: hold the attack from the east at the warehouse yard, the tank square and the cathedral. Made for Conquest.
mapDesc.persia: A small desert village across a wadi: the round square and its market, the oasis bridge and the fort, fought up close. For 4v4, light vehicles only.
mapDesc.sandbox: A practice range with every weapon and targets.
modeDesc.zone: Every zone you hold scores a point every 5 s. First side to the target wins.
modeDesc.frontline: A front pushed one sector at a time. Losing a sector makes you the attacker; run out of attack time and the roles swap.
modeDesc.conquest: The defenders start with every zone; the attackers break through one sector at a time. Only the attackers have tickets.
lobby.diffDesc.easy: Bots notice you late and miss more.
lobby.diffDesc.hard: Bots react fast and shoot straight.
settings.hint: Point at a setting to see what it does.
setDesc.sensitivity: How fast the mouse turns the view.
setDesc.adsSensitivity: Multiplier on the sensitivity while aiming down sights; under 1 turns slower when aiming.
setDesc.invertY: Pushing the mouse up looks down.
setDesc.fov: How much of the world fits on screen; wider shows more but far things look smaller.
setDesc.quality: Shadows, trees and terrain detail; auto picks for your graphics card.
setDesc.showFps: Shows the frame rate and the performance panel (F3).
setDesc.locale: The language of the text on screen.
menu.playDesc: Pick a mode, map, players a side and bot difficulty, then play.
menu.rangeDesc: Try every weapon on your own. No bots.
menu.multiDesc: Create or join a room and fight alongside other people.

setDesc.renderScale: The resolution the game draws at. Lower runs faster and looks softer. It never changes by itself.

keys.hint: Click a box, then press a key or mouse button. Esc: cancel · Backspace: clear. Up to two keys an action.
keys.conflicts: Red boxes share a key with another action: pressing it does both.
keys.reserved: {key} can't be bound (Esc, F3, F4, Backspace and Delete are reserved).
keys.crouchDesc: C by default. On Ctrl, Ctrl+W (crouch-walk) can try to close the browser tab: the page asks first, and in fullscreen the game holds the keys.
keys.viewDesc: Only in vehicles, so it may share a key with on-foot actions (crouch and so on).
keys.slotDesc: 1-3 weapons, 4 class gadget. Seats in a vehicle, call-ins in the call-in menu.
menu.tutorialDesc: Learn the basic controls step by step on the firing range. Your next match shows the deploy, zone and call-in tips again.
tut.title: Tutorial
tut.done: Tutorial done! Replay it any time from 'Tutorial' in the menu.
tut.deploy: Deploy screen: pick where to come in on the map or the list, choose a class and weapons, then press Deploy.
tut.moveTouch: Drag on the left side to move.
tut.look: Move the mouse to look around.
tut.lookTouch: Drag on the right side to look around.
tut.sprint: Hold it while moving forward to sprint.
tut.sprintTouch: Push the stick all the way to sprint.
tut.crouch: Crouch (toggle). Press it while sprinting to slide.
tut.crouchTouch: Crouch button. Press it while sprinting to slide.
tut.aim: Hold to aim down the sights for accurate shots.
tut.grenadeTouch: Tap the grenade button to throw (hold: change type).
tut.capture: Stand inside a zone to capture it; more teammates capture faster. Find the zones on the top bar and the minimap.
tut.interact: Hold it next to a downed teammate to revive, press it next to a vehicle to get in.
tut.interactTouch: Press the middle button next to a downed teammate or a vehicle.
tut.build: Build mode: hold fire on a marked spot at a zone to build cover.
tut.buildTouch: Build button: hold fire on a marked spot at a zone to build cover.
tut.support: Call-ins: spend squad RP on smoke, supplies and artillery. Pick with the number keys.
tut.supportTouch: Call-in button: spend squad RP on smoke, supplies and artillery.
setDesc.crouchHold: Toggle: press once to crouch, again to stand. Hold: crouch only while the key is down (sliding from a sprint still works). Keyboard only; the touch crouch button always toggles.
lobby.sideDesc: Pick which side you fight for. Random is settled when the match starts.
setDesc.menuScene: Shows bots really fighting behind the main menu. Turn it off if your computer struggles (a map drawing instead). Always off on touch screens.
